invariants.rationale: The returned Array is newly constructed and always non-null.
One AssetDescriptor is created in 'result' for each dependency FileHandle.
tmjFile is passed to other methods and can be assumed non-null for correct processing.
textureParameter is used in constructing AssetDescriptors in a way that implies it must be non-null.
Array.size in libGDX is always non-negative, even if empty.
